facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past this. Sunset Town in Phu Quoc looks like a European village dropped onto a Vietnamese island. Colorful facades, canal bridges, street performers at dusk. It sounds like a gimmick. It absolutely is not. 4.6 stars across nearly 5,000 reviews says otherwise. Go at golden hour. Stay for the light on the water. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Canal bridges lit up. Street performers mid-act. Crowds still thin at 5pm. Sunset Town hits different when you show up before the tour buses do. 4.6 stars. 4,996 reviews. Now you know.
